# SignupTraining

> > SignupTraining offers compliance certifications, HR training, occupational safety courses, and professional development programs for workplace professionals and managers.

SignupTraining specializes in regulatory compliance training, HR certifications (including HRCI credentials like PHR and SPHR), and occupational safety courses. The platform provides both self-paced courses and live webinars taught by industry experts to help organizations reduce workplace risk and improve employee performance.

## Key Topics

- HR Certification (PHR, SPHR, aPHR)
- Compliance Training
- OSHA Safety
- Regulatory Courses
- Banking & Financial Services
- HR Professional Development
- Manager Training
- Occupational Safety
- Webinars
- Certifications
- Employee Engagement
- Workplace Compliance
- Professional Certifications
- Risk Reduction
- Technology Skills

## Core Platform

- [SignupTraining Homepage](https://www.signuptraining.com): SignupTraining homepage offering compliance, certifications, and technology courses.
- [Course Index](https://www.signuptraining.com/site/page/index): SignupTraining main index page for compliance certifications and regulatory courses.
- [Project Management Certification](https://www.signuptraining.com/certification/en-US-All/Project-Management): Project management certification courses including PMP, PMI-ACP, and Agile Scrum.

## HR Compliance & Training

- [HR Workplace Compliance Webinar](https://www.signuptraining.com/Human-Resources/Complimentary-Webinar-on-HR-Workplace-Compliance-Overview-for-Managers-%26-Supervisors.-Train-Your-Managers-to-Reduce-Your-Risk%21-): Free webinar on HR workplace compliance for managers with instructor Margie Faulk.
- [Accounting Principles for HR Professionals](https://www.signuptraining.com/Human-Resources/Accounting-Principles-for-HR-Professionals): Accounting principles course for HR professionals covering payroll and budgeting.
- [Linking Pay to Performance](https://www.signuptraining.com/Human-Resources/Linking-Pay-to-Performance%3A-Increasing-Employee-Engagement-%26-Organizational-Performance): HR training on pay-for-performance strategies and employee engagement.
- [Conflict Resolution Training](https://www.signuptraining.com/Human-Resources/How-to-Deal-With-Clashing-Coworkers): Conflict resolution training for workplace coworker disputes and employee relations.

## Occupational Safety & OSHA

- [OSHA Voluntary Protection Program (VPP) Requirements](https://www.signuptraining.com/Occupational-Safety-and-Health-Administration/OSHA-Voluntary-Protection-Program-%28VPP%29-Requirements%3A-Brick-by-Brick): OSHA VPP training course covering voluntary protection program requirements.
- [OSHA Recordkeeping and Error Resolution](https://www.signuptraining.com/Occupational-Safety-and-Health-Administration/OSHA-Recordkeeping%3A-How-to-Resolve-Common-Recordkeeping-Errors-for-Experienced-Recordkeepers): OSHA recordkeeping training addressing common errors in injury and illness logs.

## Banking & Financial Services

- [Regulation E - The Basics and Error Resolution](https://www.signuptraining.com/Banking-and-Financial-Services-Industry/Regulation-E-.-The-Basics-and-Error-Resolution): Training on Regulation E basics and error resolution for banking professionals.

## Technology Skills

- [Creating & Using Pivot Tables in Excel](https://www.signuptraining.com/Cross-Industry-%7C-Skill-Enhancement/Creating-%26-Using-Pivot-Tables-in-Excel): Excel training on creating and using pivot tables for data analysis.
